! ADR-07 regex patterns that SHOULD fold to a domain/wildcard rule at build time
! (zero added per-query cost). Each line: a /re/ (block) or @@/re/ (allow) whose
! anchored grammar reduces to exact-domain (data) or wildcard-subtree (zone).
!
! --- ^(.+\.)?domain$  ->  wildcard zone (domain + all subdomains) ---
/^(.+\.)?doubleclick\.net$/
/^(.+\.)?google-analytics\.com$/
/^(.+\.)?adservice\.example\.com$/
/^(.+\.)?scorecardresearch\.com$/
/^(.+\.)?moatads\.com$/
!
! --- (^|\.)domain$  ->  wildcard zone (same meaning, alt anchoring) ---
/(^|\.)adnxs\.com$/
/(^|\.)rubiconproject\.com$/
/(^|\.)criteo\.com$/
/(^|\.)taboola\.com$/
/(^|\.)outbrain\.com$/
!
! --- ^domain$  ->  exact data ---
/^pixel\.example\.com$/
/^beacon\.metrics\.example$/
/^t\.co$/
!
! --- plain fully-anchored, no metachars in body (still reducible) ---
/^ads\.tracker\.example\.net$/
/^collect\.vendor\.example$/
!
! --- @@ allow forms that reduce to a whiteDB entry ---
@@/^(.+\.)?cdn\.example\.com$/
@@/^login\.example\.org$/
@@/(^|\.)static\.example\.net$/
